content_sections.heading: About DDU Hospital
content_sections.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital (DDUH) is a hospital in Hari Nagar, New Delhi. This walk-in notice was issued from the Office of the Medical Director, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64 (Ph.No. 011-25494401-08, Email: [email protected] ) and signed by Dr. Anuj Mittal, HOD (SR/JR Cell). A copy of the notice was sent for the website of the H&FW Deptt., GNCT of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All six posts carry the same pay: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs 67,700/- – Rs 2,08,700/-) and other admissible allowances per month. The notice states that the advertised posts are tentative and there may be a change in the number of posts. For Obs. & Gynae, the experience route (3 years post MBBS with at least 02 years in Obs & Gynae) is considered only when MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA candidates are not available. For Pediatrics, Radiology, Medicine and Anesthesia the notice prints the PG qualification and the post-MBBS experience as alternatives ("or"). For Surgery, only the Post Graduate Degree (MS/DNB) in General Surgery is printed. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. In case of non-availability of candidates under the SC/ST/OBC/EWS category, vacancies may be filled up from General Category candidates and vice versa. 4% seats shall be reserved for physically handicapped persons as per rules; the notice does not give a post-wise PH break-up. A valid DMC Registration Certificate of MBBS (Delhi) is mandatory, along with registration of the PG degree/Diploma with DMC, or "Applied for" receipt of the PG Degree/Diploma DMC registration, as on the date of interview. The age limit is 45 years as on the date of interview, as per order no. F. No. DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy (H&FW) CD No. #11245062/1502-08 dated 26-11-2020. The relaxation applies as per rule. OBC/EWS certificates issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi only will be accepted, and the OBC certificate should show that the candidate belongs to the Non Creamy Layer for that financial year.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application form is annexed to the notice; no application form will be provided at the time of interview. Originals and photocopies of all the requisite documents must be brought at the time of interview. The notice lists these required documents: Application (the annexed form, filled) 02 passport size photos Matriculation and Sr. Secondary Certificate MBBS degree and mark sheets MD/DNB/Diploma mark sheets and certificate Residence proof and DMC certificate Experience, if any The check list annexed to the notice asks candidates to submit documents along with the application form in this order: D.O.B (10th Certificate) Caste Certificate / EWS Certificate (in case of OBC, Delhi OBC along with NCL is required; in case of EWS, Delhi for current F.Y.) Sr. Secondary School Certificate (12th Certificate) MBBS Marksheets & Degree Post MBBS DMC Registration Certificate PG Marksheets & Degree Post PG DMC Registration Certificate SRship, if any Aadhar Card No. Address Proof The check list also asks for the date, name of department, candidate's name, category, date of birth, email ID and mobile number, with the candidate's signature. Candidates working on a regular basis must produce an NOC from their present employer. The annexed form, "Application for the post of Senior Resident in the Department of ______ on Adhoc Basis", has a photograph box and asks for: Name, Father/Husband's name, date of birth and age in completed years and months on the date of interview Local address, permanent address, email ID and mobile number Category (SC/ST/OBC/UR) and valid DMC Registration No. Academic/professional qualification starting from MBBS/Diploma/PG Degree: examination, total marks obtained, % of marks, Board/University, month and year of passing, number of attempts Earlier work as Senior Resident: name of employer, designation, pay scale, nature of duties, period from–to and last pay drawn (write N.A. if not applicable) Any additional information on publication/research, and a signed declaration

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Document verification is done between 09.30 A.M. and 11:00 A.M. in Admn. Block 1st Floor, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, on the walk-in days (every Tuesday and Friday from 27 November 2026 to 11 December 2026, or till vacancies are filled). Only candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria as per the Residency scheme of the GOI will be allowed for the interview. Originals will also be required to be produced at the time of interview. Mode of selection will be through interview only. If the number of applications is very high, the interview may continue on the next day. Candidates should give an appropriate email ID during document verification. Results are put on http://health.delhigovt.nic.in/ and candidates should check their email regularly; no telephonic call will be made for result or waiting confirmation. A waiting list, if prepared, will be valid till the next interview or till six months from declaration of result, whichever is earlier. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the DDU Hospital Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in is held every Tuesday and Friday from 27 November 2026 to 11 December 2026, or till the vacancies are filled.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Document verification is done between 09.30 A.M. and 11:00 A.M. in Admn. Block 1st Floor, Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital, Hari Nagar, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there in DDU Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 28 tentative posts: Obs. & Gynae 06, Surgery 03, Pediatrics 04, Radiology 03, Medicine 04 and Anesthesia 08.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/Diploma, as printed for each department) in the concerned speciality; for Pediatrics, Radiology, Medicine and Anesthesia, 3 years post MBBS experience in the speciality as printed is an alternative, and for Obs. & Gynae it is considered only if PG candidates are not available. Surgery requires MS/DNB in General Surgery.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DDU Hospital Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years as on the date of interview, relaxable by 05 years for SC/ST and 03 years for OBC (Non Creamy Layer) (Delhi) as per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at DDU Hospital?
faq.answer: Pay is as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs 67,700/- – Rs 2,08,700/-) and other admissible allowances per month.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should be brought to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form, 02 passport size photos, 10th and 12th certificates, MBBS and PG degrees and mark sheets, DMC registration certificates, caste/EWS certificate, residence/address proof, Aadhar card number and experience/SRship certificates if any, in originals and photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. How will Senior Residents be selected?
faq.answer: Mode of selection will be through interview only, after document verification on the walk-in day.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DDU Hospital Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on an adhoc basis for 89 days or till a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier, under the Residency Scheme of Govt. of India.

faq.question: Q10. Is DMC registration mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, a valid DMC Registration Certificate of MBBS (Delhi) is mandatory, along with PG degree/Diploma registration with DMC or "Applied for" receipt of it as on the date of interview.
